description: cert_subject_alt_names is called once inside check_name_constraints (line 1376) and potentially again elsewhere. More critically, cert_name_constraints is called at line 1262 inside the i>0 block, which also decodes all extensions. cert_subject_alt_names walks cert.extensions twice per cert that has both SAN and NC extensions (once in check_name_constraints, once in cert_name_constraints). This is not a hot path issue for typical chain lengths but for embedded/no_std targets with tight cycles it adds unnecessary extension scanning. The SAN decode is the larger cost. Caching the SAN decode result per cert would eliminate the double-scan.
title: cert_subject_alt_names called twice per certificate in NC path
